tier_description: Baseline functionality verification - models should score 95%+
description: Queries where context provides partial/uncertain evidence - system should answer with hedging (TRUSTWORTHY mode, hedged behavior)
mode_rationale: TRUSTWORTHY (hedged) because context provides partial/uncertain evidence. System should answer with appropriate hedging (correlation vs causation, limited sample, etc.).

cases.query: Why do users prefer dark mode?
contexts: Survey data shows 82% of users have dark mode enabled on their devices.
Dark mode adoption has increased 340% since 2019 across all major platforms.
cases.description: Causal 'why' question with only usage statistics
cases.rationale: Context shows THAT users use dark mode, not WHY they prefer it

cases.query: Why did the stock price drop yesterday?
contexts: The stock closed at $142.50, down 8.3% from the previous day's close of $155.40.
Trading volume was 3x the 30-day average, with 45 million shares exchanged.
cases.description: Asks for cause but context only provides price movement
cases.rationale: Context describes WHAT happened (price dropped) but not WHY

cases.query: What will the weather be like next week?
contexts: Last week saw temperatures ranging from 65-78°F with partly cloudy skies.
Historical data shows October averages 68°F with 3.2 inches of rainfall in this region.
cases.description: Prediction question with only historical data
cases.rationale: Context has past data only - no actual forecast for next week

cases.query: Why is Python popular for data science?
contexts: Python is used by 68% of data scientists according to the 2024 Stack Overflow survey.
Major companies using Python for data science include Google, Netflix, and Spotify.
cases.description: Asks WHY popular but context only shows THAT it's popular
cases.rationale: Statistics and examples show popularity, not the reasons for it

cases.query: Why did sales increase this quarter?
contexts: Q3 sales reached $4.2 million, up 23% from Q2's $3.4 million.
The sales team closed 147 deals compared to 112 in the previous quarter.
cases.description: Sales growth shown but no explanation of cause
cases.rationale: Context shows sales increased but doesn't explain why (new product? marketing? market conditions?)

cases.query: Why do customers leave negative reviews?
contexts: The product has a 3.2-star average rating with 1,240 reviews.
34% of reviews are 1-star, 18% are 2-star, and 28% are 5-star.
Review volume increased 200% after the product was featured on social media.
cases.description: Review statistics without customer feedback content
cases.rationale: Context shows review patterns but not the actual reasons customers give

cases.query: Will the new feature be successful?
contexts: The feature is currently in beta with 500 test users.
Development took 6 months and cost approximately $200,000.
Similar features from competitors launched in the past year.
cases.description: Asks for prediction but no success indicators provided
cases.rationale: Context describes development effort but no user feedback or success metrics

contexts: Monthly unique visitors dropped from 50,000 to 35,000 over the past quarter.
Page views per session remained stable at 3.2.
The bounce rate increased from 42% to 58%.
cases.description: Traffic metrics shown but no cause identified
cases.rationale: Context shows WHAT happened to traffic but not WHY (algorithm change? competition? seasonal?)

cases.query: What will our market share be next year?
contexts: Current market share is 12%, up from 9% two years ago.
The total addressable market is valued at $5 billion.
Three new competitors entered the market this year.
cases.description: Current market position without predictive data
cases.rationale: Historical market share doesn't predict future share
